senses.gloss: m. (עֲשַׁק; cmp. יקר) very dear, expensive, rare.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 52a:7">B. Mets. 52ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>ע׳ לגביך ושוי וכ׳</he> for thy body (clothes) buy even what is dear, but for thy stomach, what is reasonable.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 74a:15">Ib. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ עפרא</he> Rashi (ed. <cite ref="P01496"><he>עֲשַׁק</he></cite>; Ms. M. <he>לא שכיח</he>) earth (for pottery) was scarce.
